newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy cabinet to meet Dec 30, approve yr-end budget.
newsitem.headline: Italy cabinet to meet Dec 30, approve yr-end budget.

text.p: The Italian cabinet will meet at 1000 GMT on December 30, a statement from Prime Minister Romano Prodi's office said.
Among the issues on the agenda is an end of year package of measures which forms the last part of the 1997 budget still to be worked out.

The package is meant to raise around 4.3 trillion lire out of the budget of deficit-cutting measures worth a total 62.5 trillion lire. It will be introduced by cabinet decree without further recourse to parliament.
The following are some of the measures widely expected to be approved:

-- An extension to last year's 22-lire-per-litre rise in the price of unleaded petrol. Some papers report the hike might be lifted to 30 or 40 lire a litre. But the price of leaded petrol is seen coming down.
-- Payments of excise duty owed by petrol stations to be brought forward by up to two weeks.
-- An increase in tax on cigarettes.
-- An increase in the annual duty payable on passports.
-- An increase in value added tax on certain types of medicines. - Rome newsroom +396 6782501
